usedFor: Jobber runs quotes and jobs, and “When a quote is approved” can start “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly.

bestTemplate.name: “When a quote is approved” in Jobber, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: An approved quote can produce a booking link for the next step.

watchOut: “When a client is updated” fires on any client edit, so the same client can end up with several links.
